question: 排除分支：单卡 A100 40GB 跑 FP8/INT8。结论：勉强可行 (30GB 需求 vs 40GB 容量，留余量小)。但若上下文动态增长超过 32K，OOM 风险高。对比 L40S (48GB)：L40S 更宽裕，但 A100 有 NVLink 优势（如果未来扩容）和更高的市场认可度。

sources.title: A100: A Hybrid Vision Foundation Model for Agricultural Plant Image Analysis
sources.snippet: The use of accurate vision models for crop monitoring, disease diagnosis, and plant phenotyping in agriculture is hindered by the lack of expertly annotated data, especially in developing countries. We propose A100, an agricultural vision foundation model that is pre-trained using self-supervised learning on 3 million unlabeled images from fields covering more than 100 crop species. A100 uses a hybrid CNN-Transformer backbone that fuses MBConv stages for local feature extraction with Transformer
